item.title: Chelsea fight back to draw with Newcastle
item.description: Chelsea have come back from 2-nil down to draw 2-all at Newcastle in the Premier League's early kick-off. It consolidates their position in fourth place. Championship leaders Coventry have held on with 10-men to draw 1-all at Southampton. Advertisement There was another 1-all draw in the early kick-off between Preston and strugglers Norwich, while Blackburn put some distance between themselves and the bottom three with a 2-nil win against Millwall.

item.title: Listowel Community Hospital receives broadly positive HIQA report
item.description: Listowel Community Hospital has received a broadly positive report from the national healthcare watchdog. The Health Information and Quality Authority (HIQA) inspected the rehabilitation and community inpatient (RCIHS) facility against the National Standards for Safer Better Healthcare. The two-day announced inspection took place in April. Advertisement Listowel Community Hospital is operated by the HSE. item.title: Kerry County Councillor appeals to motorists to slow down and not put themselves or others at risk
item.description: A Kerry County Councillor is appealing to motorists to slow down on our roads and not put themselves or others at risk. Fianna Fáil councillor Fionnán Fitzgerald says he’s received numerous calls from people who are upset and frightened at the speed people are travelling at recently. He says he’s been alerted to numerous incidents including people speeding on small country roads, overtaking at roundabouts or passing out in parts of the roads that they shouldn’t be. item.title: City go top of Premier League
item.description: Manchester City have gone top of the Premier League with a 3-nil win against West Ham. They're a point clear of Arsenal - who can regain the summit when they play at Everton tonight. Bottom side Wolves remain winless after losing 2-nil at home to Brentford. item.title: Chisnall out of World Championship
item.description: Dave Chisnall is out of the World Darts Championship after losing 3-2 against Ricardo Pietreczko at Alexandra Palace. Ryan Searle, Andreas Harrysson and James Hurrell have also progressed to round three. 2023 winner Michael Smith is in action tonight, when he takes on Niels Zonneveld. Advertisement World number eight Chris Dobey faces Andrew Gilding.

item.title: Pauls defeat Brunell
item.description: Utility Trust St Pauls have beaten Brunell 73-67 in the Dominos Women’s Super League. The Men’s Under 20 League saw Garvey’s Tralee Warriors defeat St. Mary’s Castleisland 65-57. In the U-16 Boys National League in Limerick St.Brendan's beat Neptune 38-35. They defeated Bantry 58-49. Advertisement St Brendan’s play UCD Marian at 5.

item.title: Solo And Go wins Kingdom Derby
item.description: Success for Solo And Go for owners Paudie and David Clifford and Shane Enright and the Kingdom Palace Syndicate last night in the Final of the Eric Browne Memorial Kingdom Derby at the Kingdom Greyhound Stadium last night. Trained by Liam Dowling in Ballymac the early paced 9/4 favourite was in the lead coming out of the opening bend and held on in front to beat Crossfield Matt by half a length to score in a winning time of 28.24.
